usageNotes: Use this before attempting a snapshot, clone, or linked-copy operation to confirm the VM's storage backend supports it — not all storage types (e.g. raw on LVM) support all features. When checking snapshot support for a specific existing snapshot rather than the live VM state, pass the optional `snapname` to scope the check to that snapshot's storage. Returns `hasFeature: false` if any disk in the VM is on an unsupported storage, along with the `nodes` array listing cluster nodes where the feature is available.

examples.summary: Check whether VM 105 supports cloning on node pve1

tips: A VM with mixed storage (e.g., one disk on ZFS, one on LVM-thin) may return hasFeature: false for snapshot/clone even if most disks are compatible — all disks must be on supported storage.
The `nodes` array in the response reflects cluster-wide availability; a non-empty array does not mean every node listed has the VM — it means those nodes' storage pools support the feature.
Run this check programmatically before calling clone or snapshot creation endpoints to surface a clear error rather than a mid-task UPID failure.
